verdict.rationale: Goodwin has a dedicated, named Open Source Software practice page. It says the team advises companies that develop and use OSS, including "avoiding problematic OSS licensing issues and ensuring license compliance," which covers the core of the story as a named capability. Missing for 10: explicit mention of drafting or advising on internal OSS usage policies, deeper first-party detail on the compliance counseling offered, independent or client corroboration.
